rules.description: Estate value must typically exceed £5,000 to require probate application
rules.reason_if_failed: Probate may not be required for estates valued at £5,000 or less. Contact the financial organisations directly to confirm.

rules.description: Death must have occurred in England or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for deaths in England and Wales only. Use the Scotland probate service or Northern Ireland probate service.

rules.description: If there is a will, applicant must be named as executor
rules.reason_if_failed: You are not named as an executor in the will. Only executors named in the will can apply for probate.

rules.description: If there is no will, applicant must be the closest living relative
rules.reason_if_failed: You are not the closest living relative. Use the inheritance checker to determine who should apply.

rules.description: Estate must be valued before applying
rules.reason_if_failed: You must value the estate before applying for probate. This includes all assets, debts, and determining the Inheritance Tax position.

rules.description: Inheritance Tax position must be determined and reported if required
rules.reason_if_failed: You must determine whether Inheritance Tax is owed and submit IHT400 to HMRC if required before applying.

rules.description: Original will must be available if one exists
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide the original will with your application. Photocopies are not accepted.

rules.description: If multiple executors, all must agree who applies
rules.reason_if_failed: All executors named in the will must agree on who will apply. You'll need to resolve this disagreement before proceeding.

edge_cases.action: Check if will names a substitute executor. If not, other executors or entitled beneficiaries can apply. Legal advice recommended.

edge_cases.description: Executor unable to apply due to mental health condition or impairment
edge_cases.action: Medical professional must complete form PA14. Executor's deputy, attorney, or beneficiary can then apply.
May be able to apply with form PA13. Legal advice strongly recommended.

edge_cases.description: Another party wishes to challenge the probate application
edge_cases.action: Application will be paused. Handoff to Liverpool District Probate Registry for dispute resolution.

edge_cases.description: Significant assets held outside England and Wales
edge_cases.action: Foreign assets excluded from gross value for probate. May require separate probate in other jurisdictions.

edge_cases.description: Property or assets owned jointly with surviving owner
edge_cases.action: Joint assets passing to surviving owner automatically excluded from probate value. Confirm with financial institutions.

edge_cases.description: Applicant was partner but not married or in civil partnership
edge_cases.action: Unmarried partners cannot apply for letters of administration. Handoff to legal advice.

edge_cases.description: Executor wishes to give up their right to apply
edge_cases.action: Executor completes form PA15. Other executors or entitled persons can then apply.
